purpose.zh: 练髋部往各个方向的控制
purpose.en: Build control of your hip in every direction.

text.zh: 骨盆和另一条腿不动，直腿慢慢画圈
text.en: Keep your pelvis and other leg still while the straight leg draws slow circles

text.zh: 仰卧，手臂放在身体两侧，掌心贴地。
text.en: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides, palms down.

text.zh: 画完一圈，腿往另一侧交叉，骨盆要转就停。
text.en: After one circle, cross the leg over and stop before your pelvis rolls.

commonErrors.en: Drawing circles so big the pelvis rocks.
Lifting the lower back off the floor.

cautions.zh: 髋部疼或响得不舒服时圈画小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your hip hurts or clicks uncomfortably, draw smaller circles, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 派生按 work 轨道算成 8 s 2 下，与动画不符；按 spec 手算：一下 = 画一圈 3.6 s + 放低交叉 2.4 s（go 6.0）/ 停 0.6 / 收回抬起 1.4 s（rep_cycle）
口令原「慢慢画圈/向内交叉/回到中间」改为「画圈再交叉/停住/收回来」对应相位
flags: rep_cycle 一下 8 s（画圈+交叉合在 go 里），计数方式请确认
